nonBlockingObservations: REQUEST-r1.md's claim that only two tools consume inventory packages is incomplete: tools/typescript-boundary/src/lane.mjs also consumes them. Its bound-lane and package-name paths filter to typescript-package/tooling; its unbound-lane overlap guard reserves inventory roots without asserting filesystem presence. All three registered TypeScript lane resolutions and local package-name sets remain equal between v245 and v246.

This accepts the frozen inventory binding subject and the structural dry-run only. The dry-run review/assent are PLACEHOLDER evidence. Actual root assent, binding, post-binding checks, HEAD-CARRY, lane/integration and each pair's LD-Q-194 condition-4 evidence remain separate gates.
